name: A Warden of the Horde
label: Quest
description: A Warden of the Horde concludes Children's Week by returning Grunth to Orphan Matron Battlewail in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. After seeing the world…
intro: A Warden of the Horde concludes Children's Week by returning Grunth to Orphan Matron Battlewail in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. After seeing the world with his guardian, the young orphan hopes to become a hero himself.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have been so very kind to me, friend. I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week. Thank you. I won't be sad about what's happened to me - my parents always told me to rise above anything bad that happens. I'll be a hero... Just like you.
I'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home. Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is a pleasure to see you again, friend. Have you attended to the duties you've volunteered for during Children's Week?

clips.title: Completion
paras: May the spirits bless you, friend. You've done more for Grunth than most would ever think of doing for him. Thank you - you're the epitome of what it means to be a hero of the Horde.
Please - if you can spare the time, come back and visit us. I know that Grunth would like that, as would I.
Grunth had so much fun with you, friend. He wanted to give you one of his favorite pets to remember him by.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
